name: nucleation_item_merge
description: Two stacks 0.3 apart merge on the 40-tick interval (tickCount 40 at tick 39); the larger stack survives. Resting items emit nothing — their gravity-accumulating velocity is flushed by collisions without the position ever changing — so the only event in the whole trace is the removal of the absorbed entity.
